note: Made-up games for this example. Swap in your own class's games.

games.title: Lava Lift
games.pitch: Jump only on numbers that divide by 3. Lava rises every 10 seconds.

games.title: Prime Time Diner
games.pitch: Serve the orders with prime numbers. Wrong plates cost a star.

games.title: Ratio Racer
games.pitch: Steer into the lane that shows the same ratio as your car.

games.title: Fraction Stack
games.pitch: Stack fraction blocks until the tower is exactly 1 whole.

games.title: Angle Archer
games.pitch: Set your bow to the angle the target needs, then fire.

games.title: Below Zero
games.pitch: Dive under the sea line. Each level is a negative number deeper.
